items.title: Sport Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Have you ever played sports or even watched them on TV? Don't you want to be dressed like one of his top athletes?
Play as a soccer player or a judoka!

- 12 sport skins
- By Pixelusion & SeaStory

items.title: Themed Furniture: Sunny Acres
items.creator: Tetrascape
items.description:
Welcome to beautiful Sunny Acres, we've got acres of furniture! Play enhanced survival with pre-built homes, pets, a fun economy, and cool furniture to match!

+ 11 themes of furniture
+ hundreds of furniture options
+ pets
+ pre-built homes
+ empty plots
+ fun survival-based economy
+ hours of game-play
+ lots of NPCs

items.title: Skyblock Gift Edition
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Enjoy this winter Skyblock by opening gifts! But careful, have you been naughty or nice?

- 4 cheerful holiday skins!
- 3 different types of gifts!
- A bunch of different loot!
- By Pixelusion and Pixel Smile Studios.

items.title: Creeper Crowns 2
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description:
Just can't get enough of creepers? Then this pack is for you! Choose from a vast selection of these stunning skins and pick your favorite. Put on your crown, and be ready for action with this collection of 30 creeper skins!
-2 Free

items.title: Camo Armor
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Gear up in a suit of armor made from your favorite blocks. Choose from 12 different skins that will give you the coolest camouflage. Role-play in matching helmet, shield, and vest made of TNT, brick, magma, and many more. Be ready to defend and protect yourself and look good too!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Demon Masks
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Feel like playing a trick but don’t want to give yourself away? Role-play in everyday outfits, with a special face disguise. Choose from 12 super skins with demon masks to hide your real self. Show off some horns and fangs and see if anyone recognizes you!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Police Mobs
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Mobs can serve and protect too. Choose from 12 different skins that will have you looking like a mobile entity in blue. Role-play as your favorite neutral or passive mobs in uniform, with badge, cap, and vest. Act like awesome officers on patrol, bringing law and order to your town.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Winter Underground Base
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Far, far away in the North Pole lies a super secret base filled with magical mysteries. Step inside and discover a majestic hideout full of mini games, parkour, gift boxes, snow furniture, and so much more.

=> Holiday decorations
=> Candy machines
=> Winter vehicles
=> Wearable accessories
=> Spleef arena
=> Frosty mobs battle arena
=> Perfect for role play with friends

items.title: Winter Mansion
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Winter Mansion is the greatest winter resort ever. Take time away from the city and travel to a beautiful, luxurious mansion for a well-deserved vacation. This mansion is retrofitted with the latest features, from lucky gift boxes and arctic vehicles to exciting winter adventures.

=> Tons of features inside
=> Hidden treasures
=> Perfect for role play with friends
items.changelog:
=> Vibrant Visuals compatible
=> Map improvements and bug fixes

items.title: TNT Hackers
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
What a blast! Choose from 12 different explosive, secret skins and get busy. Role-play hiding behind a mask and seeing what computers you can hack. Even though you’re in TNT gear, you’ll want to decode and encode quietly so you don’t get caught.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Elemental Armor
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Let Mother Nature provide you with the best protection. Choose from a dozen armor-clad skin options that take advantage of mighty elements. Gear up in light, air, wind, water and more. Role-play in naturally awesome armor that will surely keep you safe.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Geometrics HD
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Lines and curves combine with cool colors to form shapes and awesome geometric HD skins. Role-play and gear up in squares, rectangles, ovals and lines in pretty patterns. Choose from 12 different skins with super styles and dazzling designs.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Winter Camo
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Brrr! Now these are some cool skins! Choose from 12 different options to help you blend into the winter scene. Role-play in snow and ice camouflage outfits as you face the freezing cold. Relax, have fun and really chill out!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Winter Gamers
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Winter is also good for gaming! When it’s cold outside, bundle up in skins with scarf and sweater and headset and role-play as a hardcore gamer. Choose from 12 different toasty options perfect for chilly weather. Show off a real dedication to your favorite hobby!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Skins of the Year 2022
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Epic, legendary, and super popular! Get ready to gear up in the best skins of the year. Choose from 12 different options wearing your favorite chic styles. Role-play looking like your best self, showing off your best fashion sense. It’s going to be a great time!

1 free skin included!

items.title: New Year's Eve Party
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Farewell to the old year and welcome to the new one! Choose from 12 different skins for a joyous holiday party. Role-play in elegant outfits catching confetti to celebrate the new year. Gear up and have fun in super style while you wait for the stroke of midnight.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Free Winter Style
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Goodbye summer! Winter is here! Choose from 12 cool skins for chilling out and relaxing. Role-play as you snuggle up in cozy gear to keep warm. Look like you’re ready for an awesome frosty ski trip with scarf, hat, thick sweater, and goggles.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Camo Best of 2021
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Match your mood to popular blocks? Why not? Choose from 12 of the best camouflage skins and blend right in. Role-play in awesome disguises of TNT, dirt, diamond, and gold, to name a few. Enjoy looking like a real-life block and fooling your friends!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Cyber Cats
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Now those are some cool cats! Choose from 8 different digital skins to gear up as a fabulous cyber feline. Role-play as half furry animal, half robot with super cat eyes, ears, and whiskers. Act like a real wired kitty, with machine-like meowing and purring.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Teen Dragons
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Fly and breathe fire? Yes, you can! Choose from 8 different dragon skins perfect for swooping down from the sky. With terrifying teeth and powerful tail, role-play as a mythical teen serpent. Your scales and claws will surely scare whoever you meet!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Winter Dreams!
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Who’s dreaming of a wonderful winter? Choose from 12 chill skins perfect for cold days and colder nights. Role-play in snug gear like chic scarves, toasty sweaters, and warm hats. Also look your stylish best in sunglasses, gloves, and a watch to keep track of your valuable time.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Cute Mobs
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Cute as a button? How about cute as a mob! Choose from 12 different darling skins that don’t look like any mobile entities you’ve see before. Role-play as a pretty passive, nice neutral, or hunky hostile. Look totally adorable no matter if you flee or fight.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Free Choice Winter Teens
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Live your life free and easy, if that’s what you want. Choose from 12 wonderful wintry teen skins that show off your individual style. Role-play as an independent youth bundled up to resist the cold weather. Gear up in comfy scarves, snug sweaters, and cozy hats. What will you wear next? You decide!

1 free skin included!

items.title: SCP Ninjas
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Gear up as a super secret spy. Not just an ordinary ninja, role-play as a scary SCP with martial arts abilities. Choose from 8 different skins in dark clothing to stay hidden in the shadows. Have your katana and dagger by your side and try not to get caught.

1 free skin included!
